limitations: Not proven to be the hardest 100 of the full dataset. Screening can miss difficult short questions.
No per-item model error rates were found in the inspected official release. Complexity scores only prioritize review.
Curation is subjective and can favor the selector’s reasoning style.
Original keys are preserved, not independently clinically revalidated or updated to 2026 guidelines.
This is an exam-style MCQ subset, not a patient-facing clinical safety or real-world outcome evaluation.
Public dataset exposure during model training cannot be ruled out.
method.reviewer: Codex AI-assisted content review; no new clinician review
method.scope: Reasoning-labelled text-only multiple-choice questions. Broad body-system coverage; no fixed final quotas.
selection_basis: Integration of multiple findings or competing explanations
Treatment constraints, timing, adverse effects, or diagnostic sequencing
Exclude lower-priority recall and apparent ambiguity or data-quality problems
